name: Tantei Alice no Hakei Shoudou
original_name: 探偵アリスの破戒衝動
source:
A mystery that breaks all of Knox's Ten Commandments. 

A murder has taken place in Wonderland, a place inhabited only by crazy people. Detective Alice investigates the case alongside the Jack of Hearts and the Cheshire Cat. 

A puzzle-solving (anti) mystery visual novel based on Alice in Wonderland.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11424]NovelGame[/url]]
